u9-l1#konferencia.picture: Registration at the conference, in a busy foyer: an organiser with a lanyard welcomes Tomáš and hands him his name badge; other participants queue at the desk behind them.

u9-l1#prednaska.picture: Tomáš gives his talk in the conference hall, standing at a lectern beside a big screen showing a chart; the audience listens in rows, Emma among them.

u9-l1#pozvanka.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Emma, cooking in the dorm kitchen, holds up an invitation card as she tells her news. Right: Emma's mum, at home in Ireland, listens, delighted.

u9-l1#prihlaska.picture: At the conference registration desk, Emma fills in a form on a clipboard while a smiling organiser with a lanyard waits with her badge.

u9-l1#prestavka-na-kavu.picture: Coffee break at the conference: people with badges crowd round a long table of cups and pastries. Tomáš balances a coffee and a croissant while chatting to Emma.

u9-lekar#necitim-sa-dobre.picture: Coffee break on the second day of the conference: in the busy foyer, Emma, pale and wrapped tight in her cardigan, tells Tomáš she doesn't feel well; he looks at her with concern, his coffee forgotten.

u9-lekar#boli-ma-hlava.picture: In the conference hall, during a talk, Emma sits in the audience pressing her fingertips to her temples, eyes shut against a headache.

u9-lekar#som-chora.picture: Back in the dorm room, Emma sits up in bed, flushed and sniffling, wrapped in a blanket with a box of tissues on her knees; her conference badge lies forgotten on the desk.

u9-lekar#mam-horucku.picture: In the doctor's surgery, the doctor reads a thermometer and raises her eyebrows; Emma, flushed and hot, sits on the edge of the examination couch.

u9-lekar#liek.picture: At her desk in the surgery, the doctor hands Emma a box of tablets, a small bottle of syrup and a prescription; Emma, muffled in her scarf, nods weakly.

u9-lekar#rychlo-sa-uzdrav.picture: Lucia and Tomáš visit Emma, ill in bed in the dorm room: Lucia sets a bag of oranges on the bedside table and Tomáš holds out a small bunch of flowers; Emma smiles weakly from under her blanket.

u9-lekar#choice-rychlo-sa-uzdrav.picture: Tomáš lies on the sofa at home under a blanket, red-nosed and miserable, a thermometer in his mouth and crumpled tissues all around him.

u9-l3#subor.picture: Tomáš frowns at his office computer screen, full of folders and file icons, hunting for one file.

u9-l3#otvorit.picture: Two halves at Emma's laptop. Left: she double-clicks and a document opens on the screen. Right: she clicks it closed and folds the laptop shut.

u9-l3#ulozit.picture: Late at night at her dorm desk, Emma clicks save on her finished paper and slumps back with a huge sigh of relief.

u9-l3#kliknut-na-ikonu.picture: Close-up of Emma's hand on a computer mouse; on the screen the pointer hovers over a bright, colourful icon on the desktop.

u9-l3#kopirovat-a-vlozit.picture: At the dorm desk, Lucia shows Emma how to copy a chart from one window and paste it into her slides; Emma leans in, following on the laptop screen.

u9-l3#vytlacit.picture: In the office at Tomáš's company, Tomáš waits by the printer as the pages of his talk slide out into the tray.

u9-l3#poslat-e-mailom.picture: Lucia, at her laptop in the dorm room, sends an e-mail with a file attached; a bubble shows the friend it's for, at her own laptop far away, receiving it.

u9-l4#grammar-si-yourself.picture: Two halves. Left: Tomáš behind a drawn shower curtain, only his head and soapy hair showing above it. Right: Lucia at the bathroom sink, washing just her hands.

u9-l5#dotaznik.picture: At the counter of the university's international office, Emma bends over a long printed form full of empty boxes, pen in hand.

u9-l5#vypiste-prosim-dotaznik.picture: The clerk at the international office slides a form and a pen across the counter to Emma with a polite gesture.

u9-l5#trvale-bydlisko.picture: Emma writes her home address on the form; a thought bubble shows her family's small terraced house in Ireland with a red front door.

u9-l5#podpiste-sa-tu.picture: The clerk at the international office points to the line at the bottom of the form; Emma signs her name with a flourish.

u9-l5#ako-sa-vam.picture: After the last talk, Emma meets pani Horváthová in the conference foyer; they shake hands, and pani Horváthová, looking proud, asks her how she liked the conference.
